name: smwgraphics-popful-mail-snes-ancient-cave-village
title: Popful Mail (SNES) - Ancient Cave (Village)
description:
The background seen in one of the villages of Ancient Cave, from the Super Famicom version of Popful Mail. Tilemap has been adjusted slightly, so it is not 1:1 replica of the original, but rather, a loopable version suitable for Super Mario World.
A great fit for mine levels, in general. It also uses less than 10 tiles, meaning the users have a lot of free space to use with any graphics they desire.

It is my 300th submission, hooray!

Credit would be great, but it is also optional.
